name: Stability Ball Dip
steps: Brace the stability ball against a wall and sit with your hands firmly on the ball beside your hips.
Plant both feet, bend your knees and slide your hips just in front of the ball.
Bend your elbows straight behind you to lower your hips slowly toward the floor while stabilizing the ball.
Press firmly through both palms to extend your arms back up to the starting position.
tips: Keep your hips close and stop lowering before your shoulders roll forward.
Brace your core tightly to stop the ball from rolling sideways as you push up.
